question: Do a full SEO audit of https://www.vinnayakk.com/this-page-does-not-exist: reachability, meta tags, broken links and mobile speed. Then submit a prioritised report.

report.summary: This URL is a non-existent page, and the site handles it correctly. It returns a real HTTP 404, is set to noindex, and its 3 internal links all work. The main weakness is mobile speed. The score is a good 92, but LCP is 3.3 s because the largest element is the cookie-consent text, and the 176 KB Google Tag Manager script is the heaviest resource. Meta-tag warnings (noindex, no canonical, no Open Graph tags, short description) don't matter on an error page. They only matter if the same template is used on real pages, which I didn't check.

findings.issue: Mobile LCP is 3.3 s, and the LCP element is the cookie-consent banner text rather than page content.

evidence.value: This site uses cookies to understand how visitors use it and to measure the eff…

findings.fix: Make the cookie banner a small fixed-position overlay with short text, so it is not the largest element painted. Alternatively, make sure the main heading or content paints larger than the banner.

findings.issue: The Google Tag Manager script (176 KB) is the heaviest resource on the page. Lighthouse also flags 99 KiB of unused JavaScript and render-blocking requests.
findings.fix: Load the gtag/GTM script with the Next.js Script component using strategy="afterInteractive" or "lazyOnload", so it doesn't block rendering.

findings.issue: Legacy JavaScript is being shipped to modern browsers.
findings.fix: Update the browserslist config in the project to target modern browsers, so Next.js stops adding unneeded polyfills and transforms.

findings.issue: The 404 template has no Open Graph tags and a 53-character meta description. This only matters if real pages share the same head template.
findings.fix: Check a real page such as the homepage. If it also lacks og:title, og:description and og:image, add them in the shared Next.js metadata config, and lengthen the description to 70–160 characters.

not_checked: Other pages on the site (homepage and real content pages), so it is unknown whether the missing Open Graph tags and missing canonical also affect them
Real-user Core Web Vitals (field_data was null; Google has too little traffic data)
